scientific_integrity: Self-contained structural proof and standalone exhaustive small-field checker; classification and chain-length statements already in the literature are explicitly acknowledged as prior results. No claim of independent confirmation or publication-priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Complete chains comprise all multiplicatively closed linear subspaces, including nonunital subalgebras, of two-vertex parallel-arrow path algebras. Fixed finite-field order is needed for the limit. Exhaustive computations cover small prime fields; the general proof applies to all prime powers. Priority may be affected by unidentified broader enumeration of full subalgebra flags.
title: Maximal subalgebra chains of finite Kronecker path algebras: exact counts and a uniform quotient-drop law
